Secure your AI ecosystem from the data layer up

See every agent and AI app, and the data they can reach. Decide what is allowed and ensure only trusted actions are permitted across posture and runtime.

Discover
Know every agent you have, anywhere they run

Inventory and map every AI asset your agentic and GenAI footprint across all cloud environments, SaaS platforms, browser applications, and employee workstations. Understand the anatomy of every agent with an out-of-the-box graph of connections to models, tools, MCP servers, knowledge bases, data stores, and crown-jewel sensitive data.

Govern
Keep agents on mission and doing their job

Hold agents to their intended job for all AI apps and autonomous agents by defining one set of posture and runtime policies and guardrails. Turn unmanaged agent deployments into observable, risk-managed business drivers by continuously analyzing and tuning configurations, access rights, and intent.

Protect
Stop agents from reaching data they shouldn't

Evaluate user interactions, tool invocations, and data access and retrieval against AI and data policies in real time. Alert on risky behavior, quarantine agents, or block dangerous actions before they propagate, allowing you to maintain full security control without degrading the user experience.

Validate
Prove every agent holds up under attack

Red-team every agent against real prompt injections, jailbreaks, and other sophisticated exploitation methods. Continuously verify your governance and execution policies are actually enforced at runtime, not just written down. Every validation run is timestamped, so when the auditor asks, you already have the answer.

See and secure every AI and agent interaction
with a complete platform

AI & Agent Asset inventory
Automatically discover and catalog every AI model, agent, application, domain, pipeline, and training dataset across your environment, giving you full visibility into your AI footprint including shadow AI.
AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM)
Map AI apps and agents to related identities, data, access paths, and risks. Enforce policies and guardrails governing how humans and AI access and use sensitive data.
AI Runtime Protection
Enforce real-time security policies and guardrails across all AI interactions. Whether driven by employees or autonomous agents, Cyera analyzes prompts and uses identity and intent to ensure data access remains authorized and within compliance boundaries across all environments.
AI Browser Security
Discover every browser-based AI application and agent used across your organization to minimize Shadow AI. Prevent sensitive data leakage to public models while stopping unethical use and unauthorized data access even within your perimeter.
Custom-Built Agent Security
Sanitize training data and enforce guardrails at every agent step. Monitor agent prompts and actions in real time and ensure they function safely by blocking risky or harmful operations on your data.
AI Activity Monitoring
Track what files agents access, when, and how. Maintain a complete audit trail and trace file lineage across every AI interaction with your files.
AI Compliance
Continuously validate AI and agent usage against regulatory frameworks like EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and internal policies, with automated evidence and reporting. 
AI Data Readiness
Assess, classify, and prepare your data for secure AI adoption. Accelerate rollouts of AI and agent tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude Cowork by ensuring the right data has the right permissions and protections, including files that cannot be labeled.
Flexible Deployment Methods
